description: This source file defines the NodeDisplayName enum, which provides utility functions for managing display names associated with different device types and interface idioms in an iOS context. It includes methods to determine if a name is a generic label, to get default names based on interface idiom, and to resolve the appropriate display name based on existing data and device specifics.

classes.name: NodeDisplayName
classes.description: An enum encapsulating static methods and constants to handle display names for device nodes on iOS.

methods.name: isGeneric
methods.description: Checks if a given device name is within the set of predefined generic names.

methods.name: defaultValue(for:)
methods.description: Provides a default device name based on the interface idiom (phone or pad).

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Determines the appropriate display name given optional existing name, device name, and interface idiom, applying normalization and fallback logic.

methods.name: normalizedDeviceName
methods.description: Attempts to normalize a device name by checking for certain keywords; returns nil if the device name cannot be normalized.
